# Results — Study 608 (Friday News Dump)

*Generated by [`examples/verify.py`](../examples/verify.py). The claim under test —
**DellaVigna-Pollet: bad corporate news filed Friday (after the close) gets underreacted
to, and drifts** — tested on a stratified panel of **3,122 negative 8-K filings**
(Item 4.02 non-reliance, Item 2.06 impairments, Item 5.02 CEO exits) with EDGAR
acceptance timestamps to the second, 2004-08-23 (the expanded 8-K regime) →
2026-06-30, plus a 696-filing Item 2.02 earnings control for the *timing* margin.
Offline & deterministic once cached; run `python examples/verify.py` to reproduce every
number. As-of **2026-06-30** (last complete month). Fingerprints: events `e566cab9c587`
· SPY tape `c9b5637c9a7f` (5,658 sessions 2004-01-02 → 2026-06-30).*

## Data stamp

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Filing panel | **3,818** 8-K filings from the EDGAR full-text search API — 3,122 negative (ceo_exit 1,051 · nonreliance 1,044 · impairment 1,027) + 696 earnings-control; pure `8-K` only (amendments excluded), item codes verified per filing |
| Sampling rule | per class × quarter, first **12** eligible FTS hits (8 for the control) — a documented, weekday-orthogonal cap; heavy quarters (the 2005-07 restatement wave) are *sampled*, not exhausted |
| Timing | EDGAR **acceptance timestamp** (ET, to the second) per filing; `friday_pm` = Friday ≥ 16:00 |
| Return panel | CIK → ticker via SEC `company_tickers.json` (**1,234 of 3,122** map — the *current* map), yfinance adjusted closes; full day −1..+10 window + **≥ $1** prior-close screen → **1,027 events** (2004-08-27 → 2026-06-15), 210 Friday-filed |
| Event convention | day 0 = first session whose **close** reflects the filing (accepted < 16:00 ET on a trading day = that day, else next session; Friday-PM lands Monday); AR = stock − SPY, daily |
| Execution / costs | ONE lag: enter at the **day-0 close** (filing public before it by construction), cover close(+10); 10 bps one-way × 2 stock legs + 1 bp × 2 SPY hedge legs + borrow **5%/yr** (2%/yr robustness) |
| Survivorship | **SEVERE, named on the Signal axis**: only 39.5% of negative filers map to a live ticker — firms that died after their bad news are absent, which *understates* any bad-news drift. The third-axis timing shares use the **full** 3,122-filing panel (no ticker mapping, no survivorship). |

## 1) The DellaVigna-Pollet drift test — no Friday gap, anywhere

Day-0 reaction and post-event drift CAR[+1..+10] (market-adjusted, bps), Friday vs
Mon-Thu filers; Welch *t* on the gap is the Signal-axis statistic.

| group | n | day-0 reaction | drift CAR[+1..+10] | drift *t* |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| Friday filers | 210 | +65.4 bps (*t* = +0.83) | **−45.6 bps** | −0.40 |
| Mon-Thu filers | 817 | −70.4 bps (*t* = −1.79) | **−56.3 bps** | −1.06 |

- **The gap: +10.7 bps, Welch *t* = +0.08** (1%-winsorized *t* = +0.02); seeded
  2,000-draw label-permutation placebo **p = 0.523**. The Friday-filed bad news does
  **not** drift more — if anything the point estimate has the wrong sign.
- Friday-**after-close** only (n = 130): drift −2.2 bps (*t* = −0.02), gap vs the rest
  +59.5 bps (*t* = +0.39). Nothing.
- Pooled drift, all bad news: **−54.1 bps** over 10 sessions, *t* = −1.12 (winsorized
  *t* = −1.45) — the right sign, **below the bar** on this survivor tape.
- CAR[0..+10] gap Welch *t* = +1.07 (Friday *less* negative). Day-0 reactions are muted
  overall because the tape is survivors: the firms that cratered and died are not in it.

Robustness (gap = Friday minus Mon-Thu drift): nonreliance +247.6 bps (*t* = +0.82),
impairment +109.0 (*t* = +0.88), ceo_exit −400.6 (*t* = −1.39); 2004-2015 −63.7
(*t* = −0.41), 2016-2026 +48.0 (*t* = +0.28). Six cells, six sub-1.4 *t*'s, signs both
ways — noise.

## 2) Third axis — the dump is real, but it's an *evening* dump, not a Friday one

Filing-timing shares on the **full** panels (no survivorship): 3,122 negative vs 696
earnings-control filings, two-proportion z.

| share | bad news | earnings control | z |
|---|--:|--:|--:|
| Friday | **21.3%** | 7.9% | **+10.67** |
| after 16:00 ET | **57.9%** | 47.6% | **+4.94** |
| Friday after close | **12.8%** | 1.4% | **+15.15** |

- Weekday mix of bad news: Mon 19.7 / Tue 19.6 / Wed 19.4 / Thu 20.0 / **Fri 21.3%** —
  nearly flat. Against the uniform-calendar null (Fridays = 20.3% of EDGAR-open days)
  the Friday tilt is **binomial z = +1.40**: not significant.
- The control shows where the folklore comes from: routine earnings **avoid** Friday
  (7.9%) and cluster mid-week — so *relative to ordinary news* Friday looks like a
  dump ground (2.7×, z = +10.7). But firms do not move bad news *into* Friday; they
  move it **after the close** (57.9%, z = +4.94 vs control; Friday-PM 12.8% vs 1.4%).

## 3) Tradability — short the Friday dump

Short each Friday-filed name at the day-0 close, cover at close(+10), SPY-hedged;
~10 events/yr (Friday-PM ~6/yr).

| rule | gross/event | *t* | costs (10 bps/side + borrow) | net/event | *t* net |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| all Friday filers, borrow 5%/yr | +45.6 bps | +0.40 | 41.8 bps | **+3.8 bps** | +0.03 |
| all Friday filers, borrow 2%/yr | +45.6 bps | +0.40 | 29.9 bps | +15.7 bps | +0.14 |
| Friday after-close, borrow 5%/yr | +2.2 bps | +0.02 | 41.8 bps | **−39.6 bps** | −0.28 |
| Friday after-close, borrow 2%/yr | +2.2 bps | +0.02 | 29.9 bps | −27.7 bps | −0.19 |

Ten trades a year in small, hard-to-borrow names for a *t* = 0.03 net edge: there is
nothing to deploy.

## Synthetic machinery control — the detectors are faithful

Deterministic synthetic event panel (seed 608; a machinery proof, never cited in
support of a stamp):

| planted world | Friday share | drift gap | Welch *t* | placebo *p* |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| null (no gap, p_fri = 0.20) | 21.5% | −26.2 bps | −0.38 | 0.340 |
| **drift −300 bps on Friday filers** | 21.5% | −326.2 bps | **−4.69** | 0.000 |
| **hiding p_fri = 0.35** | **37.1%** | −22.3 bps | −0.38 | 0.364 |

The null does not fire; a genuine −300 bps Friday drift lights the Welch/placebo pair
up at *t* ≈ −4.7, and a planted hiding propensity moves the share detector. If the
DellaVigna gap were there at economically meaningful size, this harness would have
seen it. It saw *t* = +0.08.

## Verdict

- **Signal — NONE.** The Friday-vs-weekday drift gap is +10.7 bps at Welch
  *t* = +0.08 (winsorized +0.02, permutation p = 0.523), and every class/period
  robustness cell sits below |*t*| = 1.4 with signs both ways. Even the pooled
  bad-news drift (−54 bps/10d) reads *t* = −1.12. **Caveat, named:** the return panel
  is severely survivor-biased (39.5% of filers map to a live ticker), which
  *understates* drift — the honest statement is "on the tape we can see, the Friday
  drift is absent", not "the drift is disproved for the full universe".
- **Tradability — MIRAGE.** +3.8 bps/event net (*t* = +0.03) at ten trades a year in
  hard-to-borrow small caps; the after-close variant is net negative.
- **"Firms dump bad news on Friday night?" — MIXED.** The *dump* is real but it is an
  **after-hours** dump, not a Friday one: 57.9% of bad 8-Ks land after 16:00
  (z = +4.94 vs earnings) and Friday-PM is 12.8% vs 1.4% for earnings (z = +15.15) —
  yet the weekday mix of bad news is flat (Fri 21.3% vs a 20.3% uniform null,
  z = +1.40). Friday only looks like the trash day because *routine* news avoids it.
